hook.name: BasedBidHook
hook.description: Fee management hook that collects and distributes swap fees across multiple recipients (liquidity donations, buybacks, reward distribution, custom wallets) with configurable static, adaptive dynamic (tick-based), or tiered fee modes. Features optional anti-sandwich protection, Merkle-based whitelist buy limits during launch periods, cooldown penalties for rapid repeat traders, and volume-adjusted fee multipliers.
